title: The Kiss
overview: Sheena is an orphan who is trained for war, even though she doesn't want to be. And one day, she meets Mimi.

title: It Does Hurt
overview: Sheena, Mimi, and their classmates get sent into the forest to fight 100 magical enemies in a combat exercise.

title: Friends
overview: After Sheena realizes she wants to make friends with Mimi, Mimi decides to share an important secret with her.

title: Accomplices
overview: Sheena tries to learn more about Mimi's condition but is confronted by Ms. Fran and sworn to absolute secrecy.

title: Endless Night
overview: Sheena struggles to understand Mimi's mysterious curse and her seemingly nonchalant attitude toward the war.

title: Welcome Home
overview: The war escalates. When Mimi isn't enough, the school makes a drastic decision.

title: Not Afraid Anymore
overview: Despite struggling somewhat during her combat test against Mimi, Seiran volunteers to go into actual battle.

title: I'm Back
overview: Ari struggles to process the material and emotional consequences of Seiran's brief tenure on the battlefield.

title: My Magic
overview: Sheena visits Ms. Fran for advice on how to use her magical abilities to better help the school and her peers.
